title: Drupal security advisory streams are scoped
summary: Drupal core security advisories, contributed-project security advisories, and Security Team public service announcements are distinct source streams with different roles.

drupal_core.notes: SA-CORE records must carry affected and fixed Drupal core ranges.

modules.name: drupal.org contributed projects
modules.notes: SA-CONTRIB records require installed project evidence before applying.

actions: Keep SA-CORE, SA-CONTRIB, and PSA records distinct during ingestion and review.
checks: Do not apply a contributed-project advisory without evidence of the installed project and version.
evidence_requirements: Installed module/theme/profile names and versions when evaluating SA-CONTRIB
automation_hints: Security review should join advisory version ranges with observed installed package versions.

enforcement.rationale: This record defines stream separation; individual reviewed advisories decide blocking behavior.
